interpretation_notes: 2-layer GCN (PyG GCNConv, row-normalized features). Trained on train+val (spec only constrains test acc), best-val-checkpoint ensembled over 20 seeds. Self-training round: high-confidence pseudo-labels (>=0.85) on unlabeled nodes, retrained 20-seed ensemble, blended with round 1. v4 skill library is tabular-focused; no preconditions match a graph-NN task.
